chunks: And it is narrated from Abū Ḥamzah al-Thumālī that he said:

The rise in prices was mentioned in the presence of ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, so he said: “What is the rise of its price to me? If it rises, then it is upon Him, and if it becomes cheap, then it is upon Him.”

key_terms.أَبِي حَمْزَةَ: Abū Ḥamzah, the narrator of the report
key_terms.الثُّمَالِيِّ: al-Thumālī, the attribution of the narrator
key_terms.رَخُصَ: became cheap or fell in price
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: upon Him, referring in context to Allah
key_terms.غَلَا: became expensive or rose in price

ai.seo_question: How did Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام respond to rising prices?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that when rising prices were mentioned before Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام, he expressed detachment from anxiety over market fluctuations and attributed the matter to Allah. Its significance lies in indicating reliance upon Allah and calmness regarding changes in worldly prices.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3966 - It is narrated from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali that he said:

Imam Ali ibn Al-Hussain (as) was informed about the rise in prices.
Imam (as) said: "What concern is it to me if prices rise? It is upon Him (swt), and if they fall, it is upon Him (swt)."
